facts.fact_text: On 30 April 1999, the Adıyaman Governor authorised the holding of May Day celebrations in the Adıyaman Amphitheatre, located in the Hasancık District.
On 1 May 1999, a group of people, including the applicants, gathered in the building of the Health Workers' Trade Union.
On 1 May 1999, the group that had gathered in the building of the Health Workers' Trade Union started to walk towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre for the May Day celebrations.

In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor stated that the demonstrators had been stopped by the police, although they had been walking silently along the pavement, without presenting a danger to the public or engaging in any violent activities.
In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor held that the accused demonstrators had not violated the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
The group walking towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre was stopped by police officers.
The police intervened to disperse the group that was attempting to continue its march towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre.
The applicants were allegedly injured during the police intervention to disperse the group as a result of the force used by the police.
According to the incident report, thirty-eight people, including the applicants, were arrested during the incident on 1 May 1999.
Following their examination at the Adıyaman State Hospital, the applicants were taken into custody.
The applicants were released from custody the day after they were taken into custody, on 2 May 1999.
